{{Quote|Missiles. Pull up!''"<br />"''They over shot us.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, during the Battle of Coruscant|<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
A '''missile''', also called an '''ordnance''' or a '''rocket''', was a catch-all term for a type of self-propelled explosive projectile. Different types of missiles were loaded on and fired from various [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Other types of missiles were utilized by ground vehicles. The most common type of missile employed by ground forces were ones capable of being launched by shoulder-fired [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. 

A single [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], or a pair of soldiers, were capable handling a missile launcher. Missiles were a often-used weapon when it comes to intense mass destruction, in wars. Missiles were not just for dumb-fire shooting, but also could be lock on to enemy targets. When fired they would home onto the target and track the target before reaching or impacting the target and exploding. Missiles could be used to launch special payloads, like [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bombs]], which could destroy cities from space.

==Description==
[[File:Rocket_launcher_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] using a missile launcher.]]
The typical missile was a ranged weapon that carried its own propellant fuel, enabling it to reach a target independent of the power source from which it was launched. Basic missiles dated from the earliest years of recorded warfare, developed from basic rockets. Most weapons of this type contained a guidance system, which allowed them to be locked onto a specific target, which the missile would then attempt to home in on. Size ranged from small "chip" missiles that could be fired from a man-portable device and were typically used against ground vehicles, to capital ship-grade warheads that could devastate enemy war vessels or [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surfaces.

Missiles normally had armor and sometimes a shield. They were generally cylinder shaped, so they could penetrate capital ship and starfighter shields.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

===Types of Missiles===
====Carbonite missile====
[[Carbonite missile]]s were devastating weapons often used by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The missile's warhead contained supercooled carbonite that, when detonated, could damage and slow enemy ground forces, leaving them open to attack. In some cases, they could completely destroy them. The [[Missile Attack Launcher]], produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], had the ability to fire Carbonite Missiles along with regular explosive missiles,<ref name="SWEAWFC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref> though it took time to rotate between the various types of warheads.

====Concussion missile====
[[File:ConcussionMissile-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|125px|A concussion missile.]]
A [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] was a general short- to medium-range, anti-vehicle ordnance produced by many manufacturers from across the galaxy, one of the most notable being [[Dymek/Legends|Dymek]]. They were vehicle mounted weapons, and could be found in most militaries' armory. The [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bomber]] was capable of loading up several magazines worth of concussion missiles into their launch bays to deploy onto a battlefield when needed.<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref> A larger and more expensive version of the weapon was the [[assault concussion missile]]. A [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]-grade ordnance, often employed by massive [[Warship/Legends|warships]] like the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]], were used for [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] bombardment and anti-capital ship duties. There were also some variants that possessed homing capabilities.

====Cluster missile====
A [[Cluster missile/Legends|cluster missile]] was a subset of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] that was low powered, yet was able to be fired off rapidly by various attack craft.

====Cruise missile====
[[File:Cruise_missile_JSF.jpg|thumb|right|125px|One of [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] cruise missiles in flight.]]
[[Cruise missile]]s were high-powered missiles capable of homing in on a target. A pirate named [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] was known to have these on his [[Havoc (starfighter)|personal starfighter]].

====Discord missile====
[[File:DiscordMissile-RotSVD.png|thumb|left|60px|A Discord missile.]]
[[Discord missile/Legends|Discord missiles]] delivered [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Buzz droids]] to their targets during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They had a popular appearance during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

====Hex missile====
[[Hex missile]]s were powerful weapons of mass destruction capable of inflicting heavy amount of casualties to a targeted planet or city. They had a specially designed warhead that contained a payload of the chemical agent trihexalon. [[Trihexalon]], also called dragon's breath, was a deadly biological weapon that was fatal to most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. These weapons were first used in an attack on the capital city of [[Maramere]], just before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

====Intruder missile====
[[Intruder missile]]s were designed by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The missile was designed to overload the shield generators on large ships, causing them to explode and damage the rest of the ship.

====Nano missile====
[[Nano missile]]s were miniature-scale missiles that were nearly indistinguishable from blaster bolts. They contained a built-in navigation system that allowed them to be sensor-guided to their target. The ''[[Guardian Mantis]]'' was known to be equipped with these missiles.

====Advanced missile====
Advanced missiles were a type of warhead equitable to some [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].

====Diamond-Boron Missile====
The [[Diamond boron missile]] was used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to take out mass groups of fighters due to the potency of its warhead. The missile was used by the [[Broadside-class cruiser kdb-1]] but were eventually replaced by [[Concussion missile/Legends|Concussion missile]]<nowiki/>s as a cheaper alternative.

====Proton torpedo====
[[File:Protontorpedo.jpg|thumb|right|125px|A pair of proton torpedoes being shot into the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> ]]
{{Quote|Great shot, kid that was one in a million!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="A New Hope" />}}
The [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] was a type of ordnance used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its most notable use was during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] by launching a pair of proton torpedoes into a [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]]. Luke was using an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="A New Hope" />

===Rockets===
A rocket was a type of missile. During [[Jaden Korr]]'s campaign against the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] he often used [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]] or a [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]] made by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]. Rocket launchers were very similar to missile launchers, similar in shape and used for the same purpose.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

==Manufacturers==
===Merr-Sonn Munitions===
[[File:Merr-Sonn.svg|thumb|right|100px|Merr-Sonn Munitions' Logo.]]
[[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], was one of the three top weapons manufacturers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Producing products from various weaponry. Also producing starships, vehicle, and artillery weaponry. The company had existed through many years and eras, helping factions of possibly both sides.

====Products====
*[[PLX-1/Legends|PLX-1 portable missile launcher]]<ref name="Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
*[[MiniMag shoulder-launched proton torpedo launcher]]<ref name="Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide" /><ref name="SWBF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref><ref name="SWBF">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>
*[[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]]<ref name="Essential Weapons and Technology">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref><ref name="''New'' Essential Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
*[[PLX-4 Missile Launcher]]<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

==History==
===Mandalorian Wars===
====Battle of Serroco====
[[File:Nuclear_explosions.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Missiles with nuclear warheads explode over [[Serroco]].]]
During the [[Battle of Serroco]], circa [[3963 BBY]], the Mandalorian fleet launched over two dozen [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear missiles]] towards the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] forces protecting the planet of [[Serroco]]. Instead of striking the Republic task force, the missiles circumvented the fleet and directly targeted Serroco's surface. One by one, the missiles struck at various points on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface and detonated, destroying entire cities and inflicting heavy casualties onto the [[Republic Army|Republic ground forces]] stationed on the planet.

===Great Galactic War===
====Battle of Balmorra====
During the [[Great Galactic War]], missiles were employed by various starfighters to carry out air-strikes against the many various factories that were scattered across [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra's]] surface. The constant bombings left the planet's surface permanently scarred.

===Terrorist Group(s)/Attack(s)===
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], a terrorist group tried to use a home-made missile to assassinate [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bartokk]]. However, their plan was thwarted by [[Jorus C'baoth]], who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to stop the missile from reaching its target.<ref name="Outbound Flight novel">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

===Clone Wars===
====Battle of Muunilinst====
Missiles were used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], notably during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilots]] under his command fire their missiles into empty space as he lured a number of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] ships that were pursuing him into the path of them.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 10">{{CW|10}}</ref>

====Battle of Coruscant (Clone Wars)====
During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Discord missile/Legends|Discord missiles]] were fired upon [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] and Anakin Skywalker's [[Jedi starfighter]]s. Despite the homing systems, Anakin managed to evade the missiles fired at his starfighter. Obi-Wan, however, was hit. The missiles flew in-front of his ship and then exploded, releasing [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Buzz droids]] which then set about destroying his starfighter.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

===Galactic Civil War===
====Battle of Hoth====
[[File:Superior_Firepower.jpg|right|thumb|A wave of missiles launched simultaneously forms an artillery strike.]]
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], man portable missile tubes were used by both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. These anti-armor missiles employed guidance systems which would pursue their assigned target with exceptional performance for any guided missile. These advanced onboard guidance systems allowed for shock and vanguard troopers to quickly acquire a target and fire the missile, allowing them to then move to a new position and reload.<ref name="SWBF" /><ref name="SWBF2" />

During the battle, the [[Rebel Vanguard/Legends|Rebel vanguard division]] would use an [[HH-15 projectile launcher]] made by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]].<ref name="SWBF2" /><ref name="SWBF" /><ref name="SWBFRS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> The Imperial forces carried [[MiniMag shoulder-launched proton torpedo launcher]]s,<ref name="SWBF2" /><ref name="SWBF" /> manufactured by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]].<ref name="MiniMag">{{CSWECite|II|317|MiniMag}}</ref>

====Battle of Endor====
Missiles were used in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the climatic battle over the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] after the fall of the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] that protected the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] snubfighters, along with the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], entered the massive [[Space station/Legends|station's]] superstructure and approached the main reactor that powered the station. With two well timed volleys of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] from [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], the main reactor was destroyed, causing a chain reaction that would destroy the entire station.<ref>[[Battle of Endor/Legends|''Battle of Endor'']]</ref>

===Second Galactic Civil War===
====Mission to Adumar====
An illegal company, [[Dammant Killers]], produced missiles from a factory on [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] went on a [[Mission to Adumar|mission]] to uncover the factory.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>
